# Incomplete Project Fixture

The project described in this fixture is entirely fictional and fully
anonymized. It contains no confidential information and exists exclusively
for methodological validation of the `project-design` plugin.

## Purpose

Represent an early consulting engagement where useful information exists but
the project cannot yet be designed safely. Important stakeholders, rules,
scope boundaries, integrations, constraints, assumptions, and terminology
remain unresolved.

## Fictional Context

`Willow Brook Services` is a fictional organization. Its proposed `Service
Request Workspace` is a fictional application.
